steps.title: Starting out
steps.text: Talk to Violet found on the southern tip of White Wolf Mountain.
Enter the Land of Snow portal.

steps.title: Land of Snow
steps.text: Talk to Violet at the top of the hill after dodging the snowballs.

postconditions.text: You should probably tell her the good news

steps.text: Talk to Violet in the room to the north.
Search for and bring Violet an item that begins with the letter she requested 5 times.

postconditions.text: No, I don't think they'll fit me

steps.title: Going on an adventure
steps.text: Investigate the frozen bucket for an empty bucket.
Use the spile on the maple tree.
Use the empty bucket on the same maple tree.
Check the four leaning trees to the north.
Shake the bushes to catch 10 fireflies.
Take the icy snow from behind Violet.
Spam click around the headless golems to reattach all 15 heads.
Collect 75 snowballs at the pile of snow to the south.
Search the abandoned crate for 3 carrots, 3 top hats, 21 coal.
Talk to Violet three times, until all snowmen are gone.

steps.title: Crossing the ice
steps.text: Reach into the icy water on the east shore to obtain a barrel.
Investigate the crate in the west.
Investigate the rotten barrel in the east.
Investigate the ice in the north-east
Chop down the Yeti Village sign to the south.
Investigate the open space until the sled is built.
Talk to Violet. Choose any name.
